summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Watchlist persistence bug  **What I did:** Read-only audit of the full path (no edits) — `WatchlistPage.tsx`, the API client, `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`, the auth middleware, `db/auth.ts`, `modules/auth/handlers.ts`, and the table definitions in `db/push.ts`.  **What I found:** Every hop in this chain is actually wired correctly today: - Login resolves a stable `user.id` from the `users` table (not a per-session id), so the same account always maps to the same id. - The watchlist routes have their own auth middleware that requires a valid session cookie and stamp
